model.verified_against: OpencodeAgent/config/oh-my-openagent.json (uniform alibaba-cn/qwen3.8-max across all agents/categories, thinking.type=enabled, reasoningEffort=max) and OpencodeAgent/.env.example (LANGCHAIN_MODEL_NAME=qwen3.8-max against DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL=https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1). Harness-side id 'alibaba-cn/qwen3.8-max' is the opencode provider-qualified id; the exact model string sent to the DashScope OpenAI-compatible endpoint is 'qwen3.8-max'. API keys are referenced by env-var name only and never stored in this file.

thinking.rationale: DashScope OpenAI-compatible mode enables Qwen-family hybrid thinking via the boolean body field 'enable_thinking' and caps reasoning tokens with the integer field 'thinking_budget'; both travel as extra body parameters alongside the OpenAI-standard fields. Thinking is ON to match the baseline harness contract (OpencodeAgent/config/oh-my-openagent.json sets thinking.type=enabled and reasoningEffort=max for every agent). Live acceptance of these exact fields by qwen3.8-max is re-verified by the todo-10 capability spike; if the endpoint rejects a field, this spec is re-issued with disclosure before any benchmark run.

generation.seed_policy: Identical wire-level generation parameters for BOTH harnesses on every benchmark call. Neither harness may apply provider-side defaults, presets, or per-task overrides to these fields; any benchmark needing different sampling requires a spec revision, not a local override.

tau2.rationale: tau2's headline metric is pass^k, a reliability measure across repeated runs: the LLM-driven user simulator and tool-mediated multi-turn dialogs make per-run variance the signal, not noise. 5 seeds (above the >=3 floor, satisfying the >=5 high-variance rule) give the paired bootstrap a usable CI for the decision gate's -2pp non-inferiority band. Cost basis: HARNESS_EVOLUTION_BENCHMARKS.md section C quotes one round at roughly $5-30.

financebench_fineval.rationale: Closed-form MCQ (FinEval subset) plus open-book QA with deterministic grading (FinanceBench-150): variance comes only from model sampling, and 650 graded items per seed already tighten the CI. 3 seeds meet the floor and are sufficient for the paired bootstrap at the gate's band. Cost basis: section C quotes FinanceBench-150 under $30 and FinEval as tens of dollars.

backtestbench.rationale: LLM-generated strategy code plus a data-driven backtest pipeline: code-generation variance dominates and subset sampling (the full 18k QA pairs are cost-prohibitive) adds a second variance layer. 5 seeds satisfy the high-variance >=5 rule so the gate CI is not dominated by a single lucky codegen seed.
backtestbench.notes: Runs on a seeded QA-pair subset; sampling rule is recorded in each run report (todo 6 owns the sampler).

swebench_verified.rationale: Moderate variance, cost-dominated: each task is a full agent session, and 3 seeds x 100 tasks already reaches the cost cap. The official verifier is deterministic, so cross-seed variance comes only from agent trajectories; 3 seeds meet the floor and keep the paired bootstrap feasible within budget.
swebench_verified.notes: Subset capped at 200 by policy; fixed at n=100 below (subset list is todo 7's deliverable).

terminal_bench_2.rationale: 89 double-validated Docker tasks with deterministic verifiers: variance is moderate and the cost is dominated by containerized agent sessions. 3 seeds meet the floor; raising seeds would exceed the cost cap before tightening the gate CI meaningfully.

budgets.notes: Suite cost cap = sum of per-benchmark caps (1370) rounded up. Token budget estimate is dominated by swebench_verified (~1.5M tokens per task x 100 tasks x 3 seeds) plus terminal_bench_2 (~200k per task x 89 x 3); remaining benchmarks contribute <100M combined. Exceeding either cap degrades the affected benchmark with report-level disclosure per the plan's degradation mode, never a silent continuation.

swebench_verified.notes: Policy cap is 200 tasks; n=100 is fixed here together with the sampling seed so both harnesses draw the identical subset. The concrete task-id list is produced by todo 7 and committed as the named artifact.

fineval.notes: Identical subset policy to swebench_verified: fixed n + fixed seed here, concrete question-id list produced by todo 5. n=500 keeps the per-seed accuracy CI near +/-4.4pp at 95% while staying inside the cost cap for MCQ grading.
